title: Dropdown popups built on <details> never closed on an outside click, an item pick or Escape

source.ref: Owner report 2026-10-06: once a popup is up it never closes, seen in several places

detail: Root cause shared by the site's no-JS dropdowns (the Space menu More and the More group in components/ui/underline-tabs.tsx): a native <details> is an accordion and closes only from its own summary. A link that changed only the query or hash (?panel=manage, #section) did not remount it either. Fix: lib/ui/popover-dismiss.ts, a leaf inline script the root layout puts in <head> beside the install-capture script, installs document listeners that close any <details data-popover> on a click outside, on a link or button pick inside, and on Escape (focus back to its summary), and close others when one opens. Plain accordions carry no marker and are untouched. No client bundle weight; covers the prerendered public pages. The probe runs the real script in jsdom.

verify.note: Runs the dismiss script in jsdom: fails if an open popup survives an outside click, an item pick or Escape, if an accordion is closed, or if the layout or underline-tabs stop wiring it.
